d:
Some melodies stay with us at every turn of life! Enjoy “Jeevan Ke Har Mod Pe” from the classic Hindi film Jhoota Kahin Ka, featuring the much-loved pairing of Rishi Kapoor and Neetu Singh. Sung by the legendary duo Kishore Kumar and Asha Bhosle, this memorable Bollywood song brings the charm of vintage hindi cinema.
Jeevan Ke Har Mod Pe | Jhoota Kahin Ka | Rishi Kapoor, Neetu Singh | Kishore Kumar Asha Bhosle Hits
Song: Jeevan Ke Har Mod Pe
Movie: Jhoota Kahin Ka (1979)
Star Cast: Rishi Kapoor, Neetu Singh, Rakesh Roshan
Singers: Kishore Kumar, Asha Bhosle
Music Director : R.D.Burman
